preconditions.description: The number of employees is at least 1 and at most 5 * 10^5.
The number of teams is at least 1 and at most 8000.
Each employee's team number is between 1 and k, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Every team contains at least one employee.
preconditions.description: There is at least one employee in each team.

postconditions.description: The minimum cost of the rent is at least the number of employees.
The output is the product of the bus capacity and the number of rides.

postconditions.expression: no team is split across rides
postconditions.description: No team should be divided between different rides.

postconditions.expression: no more than two teams take a ride together
postconditions.description: No more than two teams should be on a single ride.

postconditions.expression: find the minimum s such that the above conditions are met
postconditions.description: The goal is to find the smallest bus capacity s that satisfies the given conditions.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= k for t_i in t)
invariants.description: All team numbers are within the range [1, k].

invariants.expression: all(t_i >= 1 and t_i <= k for t_i in t)
invariants.description: Each employee's team number is a valid team identifier.

invariants.expression: all(t.count(team) >= 1 for team in range(1, k+1))
invariants.description: There is at least one employee in each team.
